Q1.baseline: walkable graph from provided paths/obstacles + shortest/simple-path candidates + transparent local scene-change score + Pareto/epsilon-constraint on interest vs repeated distance
Q1.author_route: Voronoi/spatial-index graph + ray visibility + Markov surprise/Hamming change + macro aggregation + NSGA-II
alternatives: k-shortest/simple path enumeration + deterministic multi-criteria ranking for smaller graphs
multiobjective label-setting / epsilon-constraint if the graph/objectives permit exact or bounded search
user-rated pairwise scene-change model if perceptual labels are available
not_recommended: calling raw transition probability a positive surprise term when lower probability is defined as more surprising
NSGA-II without final decoded-path feasibility replay
claiming convergence to a theoretical Pareto front without a demonstrable reference front
Q1.why_select: author route is structurally plausible for large irregular gardens, but the reusable core is the transparent scene-state/change representation and Pareto contract, not NSGA-II itself
Q1.switch_condition: prefer exact/k-shortest/epsilon methods when simplified graph is small enough; promote learned perceptual scoring only when visitor labels exist

Q2.baseline: small interpretable set of nonredundant landscape/morphology indicators + declared beneficial direction + train/dev normalization + transparent weighted score and sensitivity analysis
Q2.author_route: 10 ecology/morphology/syntax indicators -> ten-garden min-max -> force Jichang Garden indicators to 100 -> 50/50 dimension fusion
alternatives: supervised preference/ranking model if independent expert/visitor scores exist
not_recommended: using the same anchor prior both to force scores and to validate score correctness
keeping multiple 0.99-correlated indicators without checking double counting
interpreting a 0-100 constructed score as an objective psychological measurement
Q2.why_select: interpretable indicators suit tiny garden-level n; however calibration and validation must be separated
Q2.switch_condition: use learned ranking only with enough independent gardens and labels; use dimension reduction when collinearity makes hand weighting unstable

Q3.baseline: compact expert/network/spatial descriptor, standardized within training folds; cosine/Euclidean similarity + leave-one-garden sensitivity; hierarchical clustering with resampling stability
Q3.author_route: 179D micro/meso/macro vector + convolutional autoencoder/hand summaries + four cosine similarities weighted 0.4/0.2/0.2/0.2 + commonality/personality + KMeans/ANOVA + Near Garden extension
alternatives: regularized metric learning if external similarity labels exist
kernel/MDS or hierarchical clustering on a compact distance matrix
not_recommended: KMeans in d=179 with n=10/11 as confirmatory evidence
ANOVA on the same features that created the cluster labels
using all-pair high similarity as proof of discriminative generalization or cultural sufficiency
Q3.why_select: for n=10/11, a compact transparent representation is the safest baseline; high-capacity autoencoding is exploratory unless validated out-of-sample
Q3.switch_condition: promote representation learning/metric learning only with many independent gardens/patches plus garden-level holdout and an external downstream criterion
